proposed_record_text: AP3 names remain accession-specific: AB020521.1 CDS BAB03534.1 (6079–6864) is amnF hydratase, BAB03535.1 (6874–7644) is amnD decarboxylase and BAB03536.1 (7650–8078) is amnE deaminase in ENA. The 2000 indexed abstract instead gives AmnD hydratase/AmnE decarboxylase/AmnF deaminase. Current UniProt Q9KWS3 uses amnE for the exact BAB03535.1 sequence. Bare AmnD/E/F labels therefore cannot resolve these entities.
integration: Retain exact intervals/accessions and conflicting issuer spelling. Do not overwrite native strain taxon from broad UniProt taxon306.

proposed_record_text: The modern 8IH6 structure describes an engineered author/PISA assembly of five hydratase and five decarboxylase chains. The hydratase is ADLNW followed by the complete 261-residue Q9KWS4 sequence; the decarboxylase is AA followed by the complete 256-residue Q9KWS3 sequence. Deposit source taxon306 and E. coli expression host562 have distinct roles. This is separate from the historical database-reported 300 kDa preparation and 1:1 ratio; it does not prove the historical assembly had five copies of each. The deposit citation is still unpublished.
integration: Root must cite exact official entry/polymer/assembly/mmCIF sources from the identity package. No paper or invented PDB CURIE is selected by this primary overlay.

proposed_record_text: 1BJP has five asymmetric-unit chains, while each of its three author/PISA biological assemblies has six instances. The sequence corresponds to Q01468 after removal of its initial methionine, and the Pro-1 inhibitor adduct defines a modified state. Neither five crystal chains nor the historical apparent pentamer overturns the six-member biological assembly for this deposited preparation.
integration: Use the exact 1BJP sequence/assembly originals and their proof in the identity dossier; the p029 abstract citation does not stand in for deposit-version evidence.
